description: Generate a short video (~10s) via the Gemini omni model: text→video, image→video / reference→video (supply reference image[s]), interpolate between two stills (pass first frame then last frame as images), or continue a prior video (task: "edit" or "extend" + previous_interaction_id / continue_last; extensions add ~3-10s each, to ~40s total). Cost scales with `resolution` — draft at 360p, keep at 1080p/4k. Output is written to disk as MP4 (video has no inline MCP block). Video runs long — give it a `max_wait_ms` budget (or `async: true` + gemini_get_result on a local install), or raise `timeout_ms`. Needs a funded account. Local file inputs are confirmed first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

aspect_ratio.description: Exact output aspect ratio (omni: 16:9 or 9:16). `orientation` is the plain-language shorthand; this wins if both are given.

async.description: Return a job_id immediately instead of the result, so a long generation cannot hit the host tools/call timeout (-32001); poll gemini_get_result. On the hosted connector prefer max_wait_ms — the executor only lives while a request is open, so async is served there as a bounded wait.

background.description: Run the generation on Google's side and poll it, so a killed job can be recovered by gemini_get_result. Trade-off: retrieving a backgrounded interaction is unreliable today (some become permanently unreadable), so the default is off

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

continue_last.description: Continue from the most recent video interaction this server created (explicit previous_interaction_id wins)

delivery.description: How the clip comes back: "uri" (default — a Files API link the server downloads, no size ceiling) or "inline" (base64, capped ~4MB)

filename.description: Base filename for the output video (extension stripped; default: slugified prompt)

from_clipboard.description: Use the image currently on the macOS clipboard as a reference

idempotency_key.description: Repeat calls with this key return the recorded result (reused: true) instead of billing a new generation. Set it when retrying after a host timeout (-32001).

images.description: Reference image path(s) for image_to_video / reference_to_video

images_base64.description: Reference images as base64 strings or data URIs. Last resort — about 14k tokens per photo; prefer images_url or images_file_uris. The server uploads each one and reports a file_uri under image_inputs: pass that to images_file_uris next time instead of re-sending the bytes.

images_file_uris.description: Reference stills as Files API references ("files/<id>" or the full uri) from gemini_upload_file. Upload once and reuse across calls with no bytes in the conversation; retained ~48h, after which the reference stops resolving.

images_url.description: Reference stills as public https URLs — the server downloads them, so no image bytes cross the conversation. Preferred over images_base64, which costs ~14k tokens per photo. Max 15MB each, Content-Type image/*.

max_wait_ms.description: Wait up to this many ms in-band, then hand back { job_id, status: "running" } to poll with gemini_get_result (e.g. 20000 for multi-image sets). Keeps fast results inline and slow ones off the host timeout (-32001). Ignored when async is set.

orientation.description: Output shape in plain terms: landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16) or square (1:1). For any other proportion — 3:2, 4:3, 4:5, 21:9 — use aspect_ratio, which wins if both are given.

output_dir.description: Directory to write the video to (default: $GEMINI_OUTPUT_DIR or cwd)

prompt.description: Description of the video to generate (or the edit instruction when task=edit)

resolution.description: Output resolution (default 720p). Video is billed per output token, so 360p costs roughly a third of 720p — use it for drafts

task.description: text_to_video (default), image_to_video / reference_to_video (need image input), or edit / extend (need previous_interaction_id)

timeout_ms.description: Upstream timeout in ms for this call (default $GEMINI_TIMEOUT_MS, else 60000 — 120000 at 4K, which runs past 60s)

name: gemini_video_generate
